text:
Liam: apac region is seeing a sustained 250-400ms token latency spike since ~2033504200. GPU pools are hitting a provisioning queue 'gridlock' — scheduler shows jobs pending >15m. getting frequent 'no free gpu' from allocator. impact: hosted inference customers in ap-southeast.
Rachel: looking at runtime telemetry — KV cache miss rate jumped from ~3% -> 28% on many apac hosts. continuous-batcher queue depth increased ~3x. trace metric: `batch_wait_ms` median 120 -> 480.
Ajay: net stats show retransmits up on apac-edge, error-rate ~1.8% -> 6%. suspect scheduling backlog + head-of-line blocking when batches pile up.
Maya: ops-bot, what changed in the last hour? any runtime deploys or autoscaler rules modified in apac?
ops-bot: deploy event: runtime-service v2.15.2 -> v2.16.0 rolled to apac nodes @2033504050 by Rachel. Rollout reached ~60% of apac pool.
Rachel: I rolled v2.16 to apac to pick up batching optimizations. I can see a regression in queuing logic — continuous-batcher is not honoring max_batch when KV misses spike, leading to long waits.
Liam: can we pause the rollout and roll back immediately?
Rachel: pausing the rollout now. @ops-bot initiate rollback to v2.15.2 for apac.
ops-bot: rollback initiated at 2033504300; rolling back nodes in batches.
Ajay: short mitigation plan while rollback completes: 1) set continuous_batch.max_batch=8 for apac 2) disable adaptive_prefix_cache.prefetch 3) route 30% of apac traffic to na-west fallback pool (staged)
Maya: agree. Liam, execute the routing shift in a staggered manner: 10% -> 20% -> 30% over ~10 minutes to avoid sudden load on NA.
Liam: running staged shift: step1 10% @2033504350
Nina: heads up — routing to NA will add egress and higher RTT for some customers. VPC/private deployments might not accept reroute; notify affected accounts.
Rachel: as an additional short-term fallback we can enable a CPU model variant for low-priority requests. example config: ```route_policy { region: "apac" fallback_model: "gpt-small-cpu" percent: 20 }``` this keeps SLA traffic on GPUs.
Ajay: I'll add a temporary alert: if tail token latency > 500ms after mitigations, escalate to paging.
Liam: step2 20% @2033504400, step3 30% @2033504460
ops-bot: rollback to v2.15.2 completed @2033504485
Rachel: post-rollback telemetry: KV miss back down to ~7%, batch_wait median ~140ms. improved but not fully baseline. continuing to watch.
Maya: assign post-incident owners: Rachel (runtime bug + patch), Ajay (scheduler/network follow-ups), Liam (routing/ops runbook). we'll run a short postmortem and add a canary check for batcher queue and kv-miss rate during future rollouts.
Nina: also create a cost estimate for cross-region egress + on-demand GPU spin-up used during this mitigation window.
Ajay: updating runbooks: add explicit region-level escape hatch to disable continuous_batcher and an emergency routing play.
Rachel: working on a patch to ensure max_batch is honored even under prefix-cache thrash. will push a canary-only fix first.
Liam: thanks everyone. keeping this channel open until metrics are stable for 30 minutes."
